preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have authorized privileges

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or authorized address, call the cSb() function with a high percentage parameter (e.g., 100) to drain all BNB from the contract balance to the tfU (take fee utility) address, which is controlled by the owner. Alternatively, use the approvals() function to distribute contract BNB to various fee addresses (krhF, mdhS, wthT, extR) which are also owner-controlled. Ensure you have owner privileges first.
